verdict.rationale: Grafana documents connecting AI agents through a hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open-source MCP server (grafana/mcp-grafana), and serves an OpenAPI spec. The platform queries metrics, logs, and traces, with documented query surfaces for Loki (LogQL) and Tempo, so an external agent has documented access paths for debugging production. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the MCP/API surface exposes query tools for each signal type (especially traces), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
